description:
Get a direct booking link for Landhaus Prägant, Bad Kleinkirchheim, Austria.

Direct booking without commission — best price guaranteed.
No credit card required. Family-run since 1982.
This does NOT create a booking — it provides the link and contact details.

Args:
    apartment: Optional. Apartment name or number (e.g. '12', '#16').
    check_in: Optional. Desired check-in date YYYY-MM-DD.
    check_out: Optional. Desired check-out date YYYY-MM-DD.
    adults: Number of adults (default: 2).
    children: Ages of children, comma-separated (e.g. '8,6').
    language: "de" (default) or "en" — match the conversation language.
name: get_booking_link
title: Get Direct Booking Link
